item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya finds a bar magnet at home. It breaks into two pieces when it falls on the floor. She thinks she can now get one piece with only a North pole and one piece with only a South pole.
Which statement about the broken magnet is correct?

options.A: Each broken piece is a complete magnet with both a North pole and a South pole.
options.B: One broken piece has only a North pole and the other has only a South pole.
options.C: Both broken pieces lose their magnetism and have no poles.
options.D: The bigger piece keeps both poles and the smaller piece has no poles.
